analysis.title: 40x Sales And Everyone Is Buying
key_insights: Cybersecurity stocks are trading at all-time highs as the AI narrative has shifted from software disruption ("SaaSpocalypse") to an "AI security spend" boom, because agentic AI expands the attack surface.
Valuations are extreme, flows are surging and bubble warnings are starting to appear. The note calls cyber one of tech's hottest and most fragile themes.

CIBR has traded inside a near-perfect trend channel since June. It is now showing first signs of a reversal from the channel highs, with the 50-day moving average still well below price. A pullback would not break the trend.
Cybersecurity funds took in a record $950 million of net inflows in September, so the theme is no longer under-owned.
Callahan flags CRWD at roughly 40x forward EV/sales, approaching the 2020/21 extremes. The 10-year yield was around 1% then and is approaching 5.5% now.
The open question is whether earnings can rise fast enough to justify the multiple expansion. For now the trend is described as still intact.
BofA data shows cybersecurity stocks have relatively high bubble-like dynamics among popular equity themes.

sector_views.rationale: Trend and flows are strong, but valuations are extreme and bubble indicators are flashing. The trend is still described as intact.

macro_indicators.interpretation: Today's yield is far above the roughly 1% level of 2020/21, when similar sales multiples were paid. This makes the current multiples harder to justify.

risk_factors: Extreme valuations, with CRWD near 40x forward EV/sales.
Crowded positioning after record fund inflows.
A higher rate backdrop (10-year near 5.5%) than in 2020/21.
Earnings may not rise fast enough to support the multiple expansion.
First signs of reversal from the CIBR channel highs.
